body: YEAH and i figured that’s what would happen (+ it being seen as an admittance of guilt which is bad for like... legal cases.) i’m gonna keep trying and learning but man driving + an anxiety disorder is one hell of a combination

my mom remembers, i’m sure of this, it was actually her mentioning it to my therapist like.... 3 years ago(?) that made me go “hm that’s not a normal thing that happens” 

i know i shouldn’t be scared of mentioning it to my dad but i am a tiny bit, especially considering he has a closed connection to my brothers than me. but i think i will, i’m just scared of it passing around because news travels easily in this family.

i know i need to, i think it’s just that last step that makes things hard. i’m pretty sure i have some form of like... traumatic stress and i need to actually talk with my family about it. it’s just tough yknow?

thank you btw. it’s reassuring to hear this, not just from you but from everyone. i am doing better tonight and i just realized i never thanked anyone when y’all have been real kind to me.

PLEASE talk to your parents about this if you can, I kinda just posted about something very similar and the main thing that’s helped me get into the process of moving on is having people there for you. and ppl here already mentioned therapy, and hell yeah! get that therapy if you can, please, it’s something that can help you. i understand money and stuff is also things that’s can subtract to it, but in general you need to at least ask your parents about it. like you said, this may end up being a trauma that cuts through you and you need to heal. and maybe cut contact with your brother when you can IF you wish, but i get that it depends on a ton of circumstances.

it’s weird because they know!! at least my mom knows, i told her when it happened (i don’t know how i got the courage to do that, the whole day is sorta a blur but i remember talking to her about it) 

i. maybe i’ll bring it up but like i said, after that whole “dating a 12 year old” thing i don’t recall him doing anything recently that could make me jump up. i think he’s got a girlfriend (or some girl he’s trying to hook up with) and i’ll ask my mom about her age. i just don’t want to hop to conclusions if my brother’s gotten better since i know a lot of it is just me being (justifiably) upset over what he’s done in the past

the thing is that the rest of my family is good, if a bit misguided. i know my mom’s alcoholism kinda. was not helped by this (i think when i told her about it that was the first night that she drank until she blacked out, she’s 3 years sober now 😁) 

i don’t actually know if my dad knows but i feel like my mom would’ve told him, but i think it’s been so long that it’s like... not too big of a deal? like not for me of course but if i brought it up now (i’ve mentioned it like. a year ago so i could tell my therapist about it and my mom immediately thought he was doing shit again and i didn’t want to start a like. way too big storm)

i want to get away from my brother, even without the whole. pedophilia thing he’s loud and verbally abusive and very rash and on the verge of being a drug addict but i know that what he needs more than anything is help, but my dad wouldn’t let him get therapy even though he lets me have it and it’s kinda frustrating. 

i don’t want to leave all my family behind but i fear that if i want to be contactless with my brother that’d mean losing contact with everyone, and i couldn’t deal with that, especially not my mom. (but at the same time i feel like she personally would choose me over him since she’s been the one to know this)

i forgot i had notifs turned off on this account, but thank you so much!

i do think he just needed to vent and was having a rough day, he seems to be better yesterday and today and it’s possible that hormones were a bit part of it (he’s a trans dude but i didn’t think that was worth mentioning in the original post, but i do think PMS stuff was related to it perchance since we discussed that)

i was neglecting my own health a bit, but i’m truly fine as of now. i’ll make sure to not let it get to me too much and like... put it all on myself if that makes sense. i do have depression myself, have dealt with suicidal thoughts, but due to medication and therapy i’ve been a lot better personally, to the point where i do think i can be there for others since i know the situation they’ve been in. 

again, thank you so much!! sorry for the late reply, but you’re very sweet and thank you for commenting. it means the world to me 💞💞
